title: Home Purchase Agreement Statement Reference: Returned-Payment Fee Amount
content:
**Statement reference.** On a Home Purchase Agreement, the returned-payment fee charged for a returned deposit payment is the collection's returned-payment fee for that returned payment, as one amount rounded half up to the cent.

The collection's returned-payment fee is the figure on the Home Purchase Agreement deposit payment schedule for the agreement's collection.

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Returned payment | One returned-payment entry on the agreement ledger, identified by its receipt number |
| Collection | The collection written on the agreement |
| Fee charged | The collection's returned-payment fee, rounded half up to the cent |

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** A Meadow Collection agreement whose ledger shows one deposit payment returned unpaid, receipt number RCPT-HP-00000 (a placeholder), is charged the Meadow Collection returned-payment fee for that return. With a collection fee of 35.00, the charge is 35.00.

**Questions answered.**

*Is the fee figured per agreement or per returned payment?* Per returned payment: each returned payment has its own fee amount.
